issue_context.title: Shelly HT devices reporting "state class not supported" and "No states available" Ref issue: #84009
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Appears same or alike problem as reported in #84009.

- Shelly HT devices reports "state class not supported" and "no states available". It does so for all temperature, and humidity entities of the Shelly HTs.
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/13434693/ced1556d-9708-451d-8b32-471a1800356d)

- "States" shows no state_class:
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/13434693/949c9402-740e-4aa8-b73a-a976cecd6589)

- Statistics card does not show data. While it has been working for several years.
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/13434693/f4255d37-bfd6-4665-8a48-48e78e9def79)

- Units appear to be working correctly:
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/13434693/6a739f67-497e-4329-9696-65550f0bf098)

- Data is present i DB.
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/13434693/dc7c641c-f73d-48f3-9feb-f1d4060edbc6)

- Am using the core integration:
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/13434693/d6ce3656-31de-414b-ab7d-0aa32d19bcfe)

- Issue appears to start in December. And units appear to have been dropping of since then.
![image](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/13434693/db81ec1f-b5d7-4792-b355-3417eed3b233)

- Nothing found in the log book for the devices

- While this was working on 2023.12.x, the issue also started on 2023.12.x.


### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.12.x -> 2024.1.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2023.12.X

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Shelly

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/shelly

### Diagnostics information

[config_entry-shelly-e3a62a399e109eb76cbafe49969ab02c.json.txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/13929142/config_entry-shelly-e3a62a399e109eb76cbafe49969ab02c.json.txt)

review_comments:
We allow setting conditions to mark the device unavailable based on data from device blocks - https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/2d636ad4d95daac547edc0e1ea134f3e0d8c8fbd/homeassistant/components/shelly/number.py#L46
This bug existed before this change but was not covered in tests since we only tested few sensors which did not use this logic and number platform was not using the entity description when the device is restored. After fixing entity descriptions for number platform the test discovered this bug.

This was added to verify that the change fix the issue, test will fail if run without the changes in this PR
```log
   FAILED tests/components/shelly/test_sensor.py::test_block_restored_sleeping_sensor - AssertionError: assert None == <SensorStateClass.MEASUREMENT: 'measurement'>
   FAILED tests/components/shelly/test_sensor.py::test_block_restored_sleeping_sensor - AssertionError: assert None == <SensorDeviceClass.TEMPERATURE: 'temperature'>
```

This was the reason I originally assumed unique ids of the device can't be used for correlating back to the entity descriptions.

We store the unique id using `block.description` - https://github.com/home-assistant-libs/aioshelly/blob/b724677aec88ba840956c58f900e3ac00fb81fbc/aioshelly/block_device/device.py#L487

When creating entities we use `block.type` - https://github.com/home-assistant-libs/aioshelly/blob/b724677aec88ba840956c58f900e3ac00fb81fbc/aioshelly/block_device/device.py#L436 (to allow multiple instances of a sensor) to fetch entity descriptions

However they are build in `aioshelly` from the same `self.blk["D"]`

   FAILED tests/components/shelly/test_sensor.py::test_block_restored_sleeping_sensor - AssertionError: assert None == <SensorDeviceClass.TEMPERATURE: 'temperature'>
